Please use this thread to discuss this week's (6/15-6/19) latest episodes of Steven Universe.

At the time of writing this, Chille Tid will be premiering tonight to effectively bring closure to the second "new episode for every day of the weekday" release pattern affectionately named StevenBomb 2.0!

Sworn to the Sword: Connie takes up sword fighting lessons with Pearl. Note: Beginning with this episode, a new intro with all of the gems newly reformed clothing is used.

Rising Tides, Crashing Skies: Ronaldo investigates the Crystal Gems for a web documentary for his Keep Beach City Weird! blog.

Keeping It Together: While chasing after Peridot in the Kindergarten, Steven and Garnet discover a dark secret while exploring its inner workings.

We Need to Talk: Greg explains how he learned of gem fusion.

Chille Tid: The gems and Steven have a slumber party.

Have a prediction for tonight's episode? Do you like the new intro StevenBomb 2.0 kicked off with? How does StevenBomb 2.0 hold up to the first StevenBomb? Let the subverse know down below!

Sworn to the Sword: I love the new intro and how it shows Steven's growth among his gem family. The first intro constantly has Steven trying to catch up, get in the frame, etc. while the song is primarily the Crystal Gems singing. With the new intro, Steven is given the task of finishing the opening line "We are the Crystal Gems". Additionally, he isn't rolling around or flipping from the warp panel in the new intro; Steven's finally found his balance among his team/family! I predict eventually we'll get an intro where Steven is leading the opening line "We are the Crystal Gems". Finally, I really love that they all sit as a family under the stars in the new intro.

As for the episode itself, I'm excited at the thought that Connie will be a good fighter in her own right. I think the writers noticed this problem back in Ocean Gem where she couldn't really do anything combat-wise and they sought to mend it. It's also a good choice for her to be of use to the team since the Season 2 premiere dealt with Steven's fear that she'd be in constant danger. Very glad they went this route to preeminently stop the possibility of retreading that territory.

Might edit this comment later to talk about other episodes.

I don't really have much to say other than tonight's episode was as good as they usually are. I just wanted to thank you for trying to give this subverse life!
